figures.shows: A two-layer Restricted Boltzmann Machine: a hidden layer h1 to hn with biases c1 to cn on top, a visible layer v1 to vm with biases b1 to bm below, fully connected between layers by the weight matrix Wnm, no connections inside a layer.
figures.confirmed_by: This topology is depicted in Fig. 1.

figures.shows: Protocol flow: quantum hardware generates an initial approximate state with VQE and an MP2-pruned dUCCSD; its binary-vector expansion trains the RBM; the RBM generates high-rank excitations; these are decomposed into scatterers with MP2 pruning and added to the training set (loop) and used to build the RBM-dUCC ansatz.
figures.confirmed_by: The overview of our procedure is depicted in Fig. 2.

figures.shows: Six panels. (a) BH, (b) H2O, (c) CH2: energy error from FCI (E - E_FCI) x 10^6 in Hartree (y) against bond length in Angstrom (x) for dUCCSD, RBM-dUCCSDTS and dUCCSDT. (d), (e), (f): number of CNOT gates (y) against the same geometries for the same three ansatzes. Read: in (a) dUCCSD error rises from about 55 to about 165 while RBM-dUCCSDTS and dUCCSDT stay below about 10 (x 10^6 Hartree); in (b) dUCCSD peaks at about 265, RBM-dUCCSDTS peaks at about 80, dUCCSDT at about 35; in (c) all three are near 4000 at the shortest bond length, then dUCCSD stays near 450 to 600 while the other two are near 0. CNOT counts are flat in geometry: BH about 1900 (RBM), about 3900 (dUCCSD), about 19600 (dUCCSDT); H2O about 4000, about 8000, about 55000; CH2 about 5500, about 10000, about 90000.
figures.confirmed_by: the energy obtained after variationally optimizing RBMdUCCSDTS is very close to that obtained using conventional dUCCSDT

figures.shows: Three panels (BH, H2O, CH2): 1 - S (log scale, 1e-8 to 1e-4 in BH, 1e-6 to 1e-4 in H2O and CH2) against bond length in Angstrom, where S is the overlap of the RBM-dUCCSDTS and conventional dUCCSDT optimized wavefunctions. assertions.value: The authors define scatterers as two-body operators with an effective hole-particle excitation rank of one, which contain occupied-to-occupied or unoccupied-to-unoccupied transitions and which, acting on low-rank excited determinants, generate an excitation manifold one rank higher.

assertions.value: The authors state that if a rank-two excitation operator is combined by commutator with a suitable scatterer, the result is a rank-three excitation operator, and that nested commutators of scatterers generate higher ranks such as quadruples.
